verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a cloud GPU platform that ships an open-source CLI, SDKs and MCP servers, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics collection, or any opt-out setting. The security items on SOC 2 certification and containerized isolation are adjacent controls and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
